narr: Abundant monsoon moisture allowed for afternoon thunderstorms to develop over the central mountain chain, including the Sacramento Mountains near Ruidoso. Little to no steering flow allowed for storms to reside over the same location for a long period of time producing locally heavy rainfall. One such incident resulted in flash flooding along the upper Rio Ruidoso just west of Ruidoso near the Lincoln and Otero County line. Floodwaters carried mud, rocks, and debris across Mescalero Lane. Photos shared show what appears to be only minor damage to an access gate.
ev: Floodwaters carried significant amounts of mud, rocks, and debris across Mescalero Lane along the Rio Ruidoso west of Ruidoso. There was minor damage to an access gate.
